claims: The Palm Beach Post says the upcoming Season 22 of The Bachelorette is not airing on Hulu or ABC after being canceled following allegations of domestic abuse.
Previous seasons of The Bachelorette are available to stream on Hulu.
Season 22 of The Bachelorette features Taylor Frankie Paul.
Syracuse.com notes Season 22 of The Bachelorette will not proceed as scheduled.
Season 22 of The Bachelorette is officially paused/canceled.
ABC is airing reruns of American Idol in the timeslot for Season 22 of The Bachelorette instead.
